l.p: (g) What is the order of growth of the time it takes to evaluate bins(n) in terms of positive integer

s.c:
def bins(n):
    if n == 1:
        return 1
    if n < 1:
        return 0
    res = 0
    for i in range(1, 5):
        res *= bins(n-i)
    return res
# exponential
# quadratic
# linear
# logarithmic
# constant
